# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules update -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules update [<name>...] [--fetch] [--dry-run] [--commit] [--include-prerelease]

Resolve the tracked ref of managed submodules in the local refs, check out
the commit, update .lsm.lock and stage the gitlink, .gitmodules and
.lsm.lock. Without names, every managed submodule is updated.
Uninitialized submodules are initialized, offline when their repository
still exists. Nothing is modified when a selected submodule has
uncommitted changes, a missing ref or needs a clone without --fetch.

Options:
  --commit              create one commit with the result
  --dry-run             print the planned changes and modify nothing
  --fetch               fetch first; clone uninitialized submodules if needed
  --include-prerelease  let tag patterns select pre-release tags
